name: Pactiv Evergreen - Mooresville NC
type: Manufacturing Plant (Foodservice; foodservice & grocery packaging converting; ISCC PLUS certified)

fieldNotes.location: Confirmed via 2026-01 Street View on Mooresville Blvd showing the long industrial building with office front and Pactiv signage, in the south-Iredell industrial park. Web search corroborates the foodservice/grocery packaging plant at 314 Mooresville Blvd (~250 employees, 24/7 operation, $53.7M sales). Roster geocode (ROOFTOP) lands on the plant building - confirmed.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Open campus. Fresh 2026-01 Street View shows NO perimeter fence along the Mooresville Blvd frontage and NO gate - the lawn runs open from the public road to the parking lots and building. Driveways are uncontrolled open entrances. truckGate false.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth at any entrance. A small dark structure on a grass island near the front parking lot is a portable office/storage trailer, not a guard booth (confirmed at z21 satellite and in 2026-01 Street View). guardShack false.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: No gate present, so remoteGs false.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Internal driveways from the open road entrance run 100+ m to the SW dock yard - ample room for a 3+ truck queue inside the property.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: SW building face has a dock bank with ~15-20 trailers backed in (clear in z19 satellite); estimated 18-25 doors, banded 10-25. Medium confidence.
fieldNotes.dropArea: A trailer drop/storage yard sits SW of the plant holding rows of parked drop trailers and storage containers; counted ~35 trailers, banded 25-50.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-storage lot SW of the plant, separate from active dock staging - dropYard true. Note some items in the SW lot appear to be storage containers / lumber, mixed use.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property. Rail not served.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: South-Iredell industrial park on the edge of Mooresville NC, surrounded by woods and other warehouses with low-density development - Rural per rubric.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Perimeter box (~430 m N-S x ~360 m E-W of the plant property including the SW drop yard) yields roughly 34 acres - estimate.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Two open driveways from Mooresville Blvd; lane counts are estimates from imagery.

citations.claim: Active 2026 Pactiv Evergreen manufacturing reqs (machine operator, print operator, packaging associate) in Mooresville NC confirm the plant staffs and operates now.
Novolex completed acquisition Apr 1 2025; the 53 Pactiv Evergreen plants (incl. Mooresville) continue operating under self-operation.

verification.rationale: Active 2025-26 hiring-immediately reqs at Mooresville NC; no closure/WARN found; Novolex kept the plant running (operator self).
